SQL Injection.desc: SQL injection is a vulnerability where the application builds a SQL statement from unvalidated input.
SQL Injection.sol: Use parameterised queries and never concatenate user input into SQL.

Cross Site Scripting.desc: Cross-site scripting allows an attacker to execute script in the victim's browser.
Cross Site Scripting.sol: Encode output according to the context it is written into.

Secure Flag cookie.desc: A cookie without the Secure flag is transmitted over unencrypted connections.
Secure Flag cookie.sol: Set the Secure attribute on every session cookie.

Internal Server Error.desc: The server returned an unhandled error while being tested.
Internal Server Error.sol: Investigate the server-side error and handle the input safely.
